name: electron-agent-debug
description: Collect bounded runtime evidence from a running local Electron application through Node Inspector and Chromium DevTools Protocol.

interface.longDescription: Guide an Agent through attach-only diagnosis of a running local Electron application. Use the four core MCP tools to inspect main-process and renderer connection state, page targets, and bounded runtime logs after code changes. The plugin does not start or control the app, register MCP automatically, execute page code, or decide whether the business behavior is correct.
defaultPrompt: Use $electron-debug after I provide the Electron project checks and dynamic Inspector/CDP endpoints. Collect runtime evidence and tell me what remains to verify.
